Petpooja push fixtures (migration 250). Taken from Petpooja's "Global API
Documentation" and "Inventory APIs 3.1" samples (demo outlets, demo data).
Every key and token is a placeholder (test-...): the keys printed in Petpooja's
documents are never copied into the repo. order_aggregator.json keeps the
capital-T "Token" spelling of Petpooja's aggregator sample, and its phone was
changed to a valid mobile so the phone cleaning is exercised.
